tn-county-commissioners.area: Tennessee — every county whose commission is not named yet
tn-county-commissioners.summary: In the Tennessee counties this app has not reached yet, it shows which county commission district you live in and not who represents it.
tn-county-commissioners.why: The state publishes every county's districts but not who holds them, so the names come from each county's own pages, a group of counties at a time, and this app has not reached every county yet.
tn-county-commissioners.wanted: Nothing from a reader — this one is ours to build.

tn-municipal-officeholders.summary: This app can tell you which Tennessee city or town you are in, and not who your mayor or council members are.
tn-municipal-officeholders.why: No statewide list of Tennessee's mayors and council members has been read yet. The boundary this card draws carries geography and no officeholder at all, and this app never guesses a name.
tn-municipal-officeholders.wanted: A statewide roster of municipal mayors and council or board members, or each city's own published list.

tn-school-board-members.summary: This app names your school district and not the people elected to run it.
tn-school-board-members.why: Tennessee's school boards are elected, and no statewide list of their members has been read yet. The boundary this card draws carries the district's name and grades and nothing about its board.
tn-school-board-members.wanted: A statewide roster of school board members, or each district's own published list of its board.
